title: Ultimate Frames
body:
# Ultimate Frames Performance Modpack

Hey everyone! 👋

I built Ultimate Frames to deliver the absolute best performance in Minecraft — no content mods, no bloat, just pure speed and smoothness.

This pack combines every compatible optimization mod into one clean stack. The result is higher FPS, faster world loading, smoother chunk generation, fewer stutters, and lower memory usage even at high render distances.

### Core Mods
- Sodium + Iris + Endium
- Lithium
- C2ME (insane chunk loading)
- ScalableLux\Starlight (lighting)
- NoisiumForked
- ModernFix
- FerriteCore
- Entity Culling, ImmediatelyFast, Dynamic FPS, and more

**NOTE:** All mods are carefully chosen to work together perfectly, updating the mods sometimes can cause crashes\not launching. This modpack was made on Fabric for **Minecraft 1.16.5-Current version**.

### How to Use
1. Download the .mrpack using Modrinth App or Prism Launcher.
2. Import and launch the pack.

This pack is 100% performance-focused and makes a great base if you want to add other mods later.

Got suggestions or new optimization mods? Drop them in the comments — I plan to keep this pack updated!

Thanks for checking it out. Hope you hit those high FPS numbers!

— asdathh
